title: Pilot Launch Ops Checklist & Swimlane
summary: Working ops checklist and swimlane for Customer X pilot launch. Purpose: coordinate infra, model, and integration tasks so the two-week pilot reaches defined acceptance criteria with clear owners and contingency plans.
objectives: Provision isolated dedicated capacity for Customer X (single-tenant slice)
Validate end-to-end latency under target SLO (95th percentile < 220ms for 512 tokens)
Demonstrate model quality parity vs. baseline prompts for top-3 intents
Enable rollbacks and automated fallback routing to hosted variants
Deliver a customer-facing runbook and 2 workshop sessions (tech + ops)
success_criteria: Throughput: sustain 150 rps steady-state for 30s without queueing > 250ms
Quality: intent accuracy >= 92% on evaluation suite (gold prompts)
Stability: no unrecoverable infra incidents during 48-hour soak
Onboarding: customer can run a basic inference flow end-to-end without SE assistance within 60 minutes
milestones: Day -5: Dedicated capacity provisioned (GPU pool allocated)
Day -3: Model artifact uploaded, version pinned (v2025-11-1) and quantization profile applied
Day -2: Integration smoke tests pass (auth, network, route mapping)
Day 0: Technical workshop - walk customer through topology and runbook
Day 3: Load test and KV caching validation
Day 7: Business review - early KPIs and acceptance decision
Day 14: Pilot closeout & handoff to customer success or extension

risks: Customer network restrictions prevent VPC peering -> mitigation: use secure tunnel + temporary hosted bridge
Quantization introduces subtle hallucination regressions -> mitigation: keep float variant as fallback and run evals on golden set
Provision delay from cloud provider -> mitigation: pre-reserve soft capacity and notify customer of contingency window
Unexpected token cost spike during load test -> mitigation: throttle burst, enable prefix cache and apply cost guard
workshop_agenda: Tech Workshop (90m): architecture overview (15m), infra walkthrough (20m), model and prompt hygiene (20m), integration demo (20m), Q&A & next steps (15m)
Ops Workshop (60m): runbook read-through (15m), incident playbook simulation (20m), rollout/fallback policy review (15m), acceptance checklist (10m)
prep_items: Customer: sample request/response pairs and traffic profile
SE: bring runbook draft, traffic generator scripts, and current latency dashboards
SRE: pre-validate routing and ACL test vectors
Security: finalize data handling agreement and KMS key provisioning steps
communication_plan: Daily check-in via shared Slack channel (pilot-customer-x) at 10:30 PT; escalation to oncall SRE if infra P1; end-of-day summary in Confluence; business updates to customer in scheduled weekly 30m call.
acceptance_criteria: Customer signs off on the acceptance checklist in the Day 7 business review: stability metrics met, quality tests pass on golden prompts, and customer able to run sample flows with internal users.
